action: Chow Sang Sang members: be wary of calls, texts or emails that mention your orders or card ending, and change the account password if reused elsewhere. Full card numbers were not reported exposed; no card replacement is indicated.
exec: A customer loyalty system breach at a Hong Kong retailer exposed contact and order data; the number affected is undisclosed.
plain: Someone gained unauthorised access to jeweller Chow Sang Sang's membership system, exposing names, phone numbers, emails, order details and the last four digits of payment cards for customers and staff.
summary: Unauthorized access to the jeweler's membership system exposed customer and employee names, phone numbers, emails, order details and the last four digits of cards. No record count has been disclosed.
title: Chow Sang Sang membership system breached
